notes: Added remaining stories to complete core logic, recovery, and test coverage for Brain lock TTL.

GOV-F-003-S145.title: TTL Expiration and Ownership Enforcement Logic
GOV-F-003-S145.description: Implement core lock logic enforcing TTL expiration, ownership validation, and rejection of stale or conflicting lock operations. Ensure expired locks can be safely overridden.

GOV-F-003-S146.title: Lock Recovery and Deadlock Resolution
GOV-F-003-S146.description: Implement recovery workflow to detect abandoned locks (missed heartbeats, expired TTL) and safely reclaim them. Include deadlock prevention rules and audit logging for recovery actions.

GOV-F-003-S147.title: Lock Lifecycle Tests and Failure Scenarios
GOV-F-003-S147.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquire, heartbeat refresh, TTL expiry, ownership conflicts, and recovery scenarios including concurrent access simulation.

GOV-F-003.mitigation: Enforce strict TTL checks and ownership validation before any lock mutation; log all recovery actions for traceability.
